newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.AFRICA BOURSE HEAD TO JOIN LIBERTY LIFE.
newsitem.headline: S.AFRICA BOURSE HEAD TO JOIN LIBERTY LIFE.

text.p: Insurance giant Liberty Life said on Thursday that outgoing Johannesburg Stock Exchange (JSE) executive president Roy Andersen would join the group as chief executive designate from April 1, 1997.
Current Liberty chief executive Donald Gordon is expected to gradually withdraw from his routine executive role over the next few years and assume the position of non-executive chairman.
Andersen will complete his current term as head of the JSE on February 28 next year.

"As chief executive designate, his (Andersen's) major role will be that of gradually relieving the chairman of his executive responsibilities and duties as chief executive," Liberty said in a statement.
Gordon has been at the head of Liberty for the past 40 years.

Andersen's career saw him start off as an accountant with Ernst & Young and rise to be the firm's chairman by 1988. He also recently completed a term as chairman of the African Stock Exchanges Association.
